summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the formatter entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool gated only on is_terminal, with a Google-style docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title) once per title control; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (asserts only when console.legacy_windows is false), and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and mypy are unverified. Nothing committed.
